relations.statement: Exactly 20 of the 64 sign masks have positiveCount = 3
A Szollosi quartet exists iff there is a table solution with a coded box
For balanced masks (positiveCount = 3), the squared norm of the Laurent expression equals 9

lemmas.statement: The number of balanced masks among 64 is 20
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_balanced_count : ((List.finRange 64).filter fun m => MUB.SzollosiLaurentPairing.positiveCount m = 3).length = 20 := MUB.SzollosiLaurentPairing.balanced_mask_count

lemmas.statement: Existence of a quartet is equivalent to a coded table solution, which reduces Conjecture 3 to a table question
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_quartet_table : (∃ Q, MUB.SzollosiQuartetSystem.Quartet Q) ↔ ∃ x, MUB.BalancedTable.TableSolution x ∧ MUB.BalancedTable.CodedBox x := MUB.BalancedTable.exists_quartet_iff_table

lemmas.statement: Conjecture 2 and Conjecture 3 together imply at most three MUBs in C^6 (Proposition 4.2)
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem l_prop42 (C2 C3 : Prop) (h2 : C2) (h3 : C3) : True := by sorry

near_misses.claim: The proven Tao balanced Laurent norm identity gives Conjecture 2 on actual MUB triples
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The Tao identity is for formal Laurent expressions on masks with norm squared 9, not vanishing on actual MUB triples.

open_obligations: Proposition 4.2 is not formalized as a Lean theorem with the real hypotheses
No generator composition can be licensed by an existing relation
Row-count table compatibility is a field, not a proven fact
